messages:
maya.csm: Heads up — NimbleTech renewal scheduled for next Tuesday. They've asked for a 15% price reduction and want to stretch to an 18‑month term. Procurement insists on PO vs card, and legal flagged a data residency clause. Onboarding still ~40% done, risk of slip if we wait on PO.
raj.sales: Do we have authority to approve a 15% cut? We already applied credits last quarter. What's the ACV hit if we do both term + discount?
maya.csm: Quick calc: if we accept 15% + 18mo instead of 12, ACV drops ~12% y/y. They say procurement needs PO and finance wants net60.
jamie.revops: Option: offer a one‑time onboarding credit to offset cost instead of a recurring price cut — preserves list price and ACV. How much would cover their ask?
maya.csm: They quoted $25k reduction preference. Could we offer a $20k onboarding credit + standard pricing? That would be less ACV erosion.
priya.legal: Important: the clause they pasted requests 2yr on‑prem log retention. That's outside our standard commitments. We need clarifying language — can we offer limited export for audits or encrypted log export instead?
ton y.onboard: Onboarding blockers we can solve quickly: SSO integration and sandbox cluster. If they send IdP metadata today, SSO estimated 3 business days. Sandbox provisioning is 1 day once we get final scope.
maya.csm: I emailed their procurement contact for the PO template and cc'd finance. They've paused signature until legal agrees.
raj.sales: If legal can't accept their clause, what's our fallback to avoid losing the deal? Trial extension? Deferred start?
jamie.revops: We can do a 30‑day trial/extension under current T&Cs to buy time. Need a provisional invoice and approval from billing to avoid revenue leakage. @billing-bot — can you create a provisional invoice/net30 placeholder?
billing-bot: Created provisional invoice INV-NT-2026-0423 (provisional, net30). Link: https://invoices.redwood/INV-NT-2026-0423. Notify if fields need edits.
maya.csm: Great — I'll propose: 30‑day extension + $20k onboarding credit (one‑time) in lieu of 15% discount. Priya, can you draft a legal compromise around logs: "temporary encrypted export for audit purposes with max retention 90 days" as an alternative?
priya.legal: I'll draft suggested language and loop in security for review. ETA EOD today. If security objects, we escalate to product for technical feasibility.
raj.sales: I'm inclined to approve $20k onboarding credit instead of list discount. :thumbsup:
maya.csm: Thanks — I'll update NimbleTech with the proposal, request their PO template, and push for IdP metadata for SSO. Will log any pushback here.
priya.legal: Draft uploaded to the shared drive and sent to security for quick review. Link (internal): https://redwood.share/drafts/nimbletech‑log‑clause
maya.csm: Perfect. If procurement returns PO with net60, can revops accept net60 on the invoice or must finance stick to net30?
jamie.revops: Finance prefers net30, but we can accept net60 for enterprise customers pending credit approval. Need formal approval from finance lead — I'll ping them now.
maya.csm: Ok — thanks team. I'll keep this thread as the source of truth for approvals and customer comms.
